context.body: Instruction from Moses and personal requests for judgment are delivered together.

observations.body: David commands courage and covenant obedience, recalls the promise, and gives instructions concerning Joab, Barzillai’s sons, and Shimei.
observations.label: David gives Solomon a final charge: action

observations.body: Solomon inherits both the covenant horizon and David’s unfinished political accounts.
observations.label: David gives Solomon a final charge: response

observations.body: be strong · keep the instruction · deal according to wisdom · throne established

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 2:1–12 as promise and succession evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The charge places covenant faithfulness beside violent dynastic business without explaining away the moral tension.
